title: Terragrunt Auth Provider Command Response Schema
description: Schema for the JSON response expected from an auth provider command

awsCredentials.description: AWS credentials to set as environment variables

roleARN.description: The ARN of the IAM role to assume

roleSessionName.description: The session name for the assumed role

duration.description: Duration in seconds for the assumed role session

webIdentityToken.description: Web identity token for OIDC-based role assumption

cache.description: Units that share this response and how long Terragrunt may reuse it

root.description: Directory the globs are relative to. repo is the top level of the git repository that contains the unit

globs.description: Patterns in the syntax of a --filter path, matched against the unit directory relative to root, with forward slashes

ttl.description: Seconds the response may be reused. Zero disables caching. A negative value marks the response as a preflight
